pullRequests.title: fix(lock-strafe): keep L2 and R2 for hoverboard tricks
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/lock-strafe-hoverboard
pullRequests.body:
The strafe mod turns off on the hoverboard (control mode 0x16), so L2 and R2 do tricks.
It turns back on when Ratchet gets off the board.
🤖 Generated with Claude Code

pullRequests.title: feat(archipelago): Archipelago multiworld support
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/archipelago
pullRequests.body:
Adds the archipelago mod: plays RAC1 in an Archipelago multiworld, beat Drek to finish.
Adds rac1.apworld, built and tested in CI against Archipelago 0.6.8.
🤖 Generated with Claude Code

pullRequests.title: fix(ci): put rac1.apworld in the release
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: fix/release-apworld
pullRequests.body:
The merge job did not upload rac1.apworld, so releases missed it.
It now uploads dist/*.apworld with the zips.
🤖 Generated with Claude Code

pullRequests.title: feat(index): signed mod index, submission bot and media pipeline
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/mod-index
pullRequests.body:
Builds and signs index.json (the mod list openrac.dev and the launcher read) and publishes it on the index pre-release.
Adds the submission issue forms and bot, picture pipeline, native cool-down and Discussions; tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests.

pullRequests.title: chore: rename rac1-mods to openrac-mods
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: chore/rename-openrac-mods
pullRequests.body:
Every rac1-mods reference (index source and media address, mod homepages, READMEs, forms, tests and fixtures) now names openrac-mods.
Verified: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests passes; the shared fixture changed, so the site and launcher copies follow.

pullRequests.title: feat(bot): act as openrac-bot, the organization's GitHub App
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/openrac-bot
pullRequests.body:
The submission, review, Discussions and broken-index jobs now act as openrac-bot (its name and logo, and its PRs start CI), each with a one-hour token scoped to that job; the default workflow token drops to read-only there.
Verified: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests passes, both workflows parse; actionlint and zizmor run in this PR's CI.
